subject: Recap + pricing slices for Novum pilot (attach: estimate & calc)
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena@novumai.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Recap + pricing slices for Novum pilot (attach: estimate & calc)

Hi Elena —

Great to connect earlier. Quick recap from our discovery so we have a clean starting point and next steps for the pilot pricing conversation. I attached a working estimate (novum-pilot-estimate-v1.xlsx) and a short breakdown PDF.

What we covered
- Pilot scope: 4–8 weeks, feature surface = chat + summarization for two core flows (inbound support & internal notes).
- Expected volume (your estimate): 8–12M tokens/month during pilot, scaling to ~40–60M tokens/month in Q1 if signals are positive.
- Key constraint: procurement needs to stay in a $5k–$15k/month pilot budget to greenlight internal stakeholders.

Questions / asks for you (so I can finalize the estimate)
1) Can you confirm whether the 8–12M/month is total tokens (input+output) or output-only?
2) What target $/1M tokens would make the pilot feasible within your $5k–$15k/month range? You mentioned a target in the $250–$350/1M ballpark on the call — is that still the goal?
3) Any procurement timelines or PO requirements we should include in the invoice?

What I attached
- novum-pilot-estimate-v1.xlsx — two scenarios: (A) On-demand (no commitment), (B) 3-month reserved slice (discounted unit). Includes line items for compute, KV cache, storage, and a 10% support/observability uplift.
- novum-pricing-breakdown.pdf — one-pager showing how we compute $/1M tokens by line item and an example invoice for 12M tokens.

Proposed next steps
- You confirm the token accounting (input vs total) and target $/1M.
- I’ll update the spreadsheet and share a formal invoice estimate + payment/SOW path.
- Schedule a quick procurement sync next week if you want to move to a PO.

Thanks — I’ll hold off on formal discounts until we confirm volumes so we size the reserved option correctly.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0143

Attachments: novum-pilot-estimate-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), novum-pricing-breakdown.pdf (one-pager)

From: Elena Morris <elena@novumai.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap + pricing slices for Novum pilot (attach: estimate & calc)

Alex —

Thanks for the recap and the files. Quick answers below so you can update the estimate: 

1) Tokens: the numbers I quoted were total tokens (input + output). We see roughly a 2.2x input->output multiplier on average for our flows, FYI.
2) Target unit price: to keep the pilot inside procurement’s limits we need something around $250–$300 per 1M tokens for the pilot period. If the unit can drop to ~$180–$200/1M at scale (40–60M/month) we can make a case for expansion.
3) Procurement timeline: procurement needs an invoice + SOW, and they typically process a PO within 7–10 business days once we submit paperwork. I’m copying procurement so they can flag any required fields.

We’ll also need an invoice that shows a monthly cadence and a short note about data handling (SOC2 & audit logs) — your compliance slide during the call was helpful; include SOC2 cert details in the SOW addendum.

Elena
Elena Morris
Head of Product, Novum AI
elena@novumai.com

Subject: Updated estimate + pricing slices (pilot on-demand vs reserved)

Hi Elena / procurement team —

Thanks for the quick confirmation. I’ve updated the spreadsheet and attached a version with the unit math surfaced. Highlights:

- Pilot scenarios (monthly, 12M tokens shown as example):
  • On-demand: $385 / 1M tokens (line items: GPU compute, model overhead, storage, observability).
  • 3-month reserved slice (20% discount): $308 / 1M tokens.
- To meet your $250–$300/1M pilot target we can offer a limited pilot discount (additional 10% on the reserved slice) contingent on a 3-month commit and a simple PO. That would put the pilot unit at ~ $277 / 1M.
- For scale (40–60M/month) the blended unit can be driven to ~$190–$220/1M with a combination of reserved sizing and higher utilization; I’ve included a projection tab in the spreadsheet.

I attached: novum-pilot-estimate-v1.xlsx (updated) and novum-pricing-breakdown.pdf (annotated). The spreadsheet has a short notes tab with the assumptions (avg token length, KV cache hit rate, batch sizes) so procurement can validate the model.

If that reserved+pilot-discount approach sounds reasonable, we can draft a one-page SOW + invoice for the PO. I’ve also included a sample invoice row so procurement has the exact fields.

Next step suggested: 30-minute procurement review on Friday to walk the invoice fields and acceptance criteria. Are you available Fri 13th at 10am PT?

Best,
Alex

Attachments: novum-pilot-estimate-v1.xlsx, novum-pricing-breakdown.pdf

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Fwd: Updated estimate + pricing slices (pilot on-demand vs reserved)

CONFIDENTIAL — internal

Alex — I reviewed the numbers. If we commit to the 10% pilot discount on top of the reserved 20% slice (puts pilot at ~ $277/1M) we should cap the discount to the pilot term (3 months) and require a short usage floor (e.g., 8M tokens/month) to avoid churn loss. Also recommend we keep a clause: automatic re-eval after month 2 for scaling triggers.

Marissa — thoughts on approving the additional 10% pilot promo (expected lift on conversion vs cost)? If OK I’ll draft the one-page SOW and mark it as pilot-only discount.

—Lauren

lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
